subject.title: fix(browser): prove post-action target continuity before adopting a tab

question: Should this PR temporarily accept stale target IDs for extension-relay and Chrome MCP replacement flows, or must their backend-owned continuity contracts land before the shared route fallback is removed?
rationale: The safe Playwright fix is complete, but the branch intentionally changes existing relay/MCP recovery behavior and only a maintainer can decide whether that compatibility break is acceptable while owner-specific work remains deferred.

options.title: Complete backend outcomes first
options.body: Require stable extension-relay and Chrome MCP target outcomes or handles, with focused regression proof, before removing the shared continuity fallback.

options.title: Accept temporary fail-stale behavior
options.body: Merge the Playwright safety improvement now and explicitly accept that affected relay/MCP users must reselect a tab after replacement until follow-up work lands.

recommendation.title: Complete backend outcomes first
recommendation.body: Require stable extension-relay and Chrome MCP target outcomes or handles, with focused regression proof, before removing the shared continuity fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The canonical report defines the desired cross-backend contract and the PR discussion requests this browser-scope decision from them.
